protocol.purpose: Repair totals probability construction without tuning to reused 2025/2026 outcomes.
protocol.training: 2023 prior-game raw possession totals; do not use the old score calibration fitted on all 2023 outcomes
features: raw possession total minus consensus total, divided by 10
protocol.regularization: Choose ridge penalty from 10,100,1000 using rolling 2023 weeks 6,9,12 with next-three-week squared error. Fit on 2023 only.
protocol.distribution: Smoothed discrete residual distribution from rolling 2023 predictions only, logistic kernel bandwidth 2 points, support integer scores 0 through 250. Never use future game residuals.
protocol.calibration: 2024 development calibration groups, minimum 30 decisions and 4 weeks; no claim of untouched validation because legacy possession shrinkage was selected on 2024
protocol.diagnostics: 2025 and 2026 are already inspected retrospective samples. Evaluate same-game old/new/market MAE, Brier, log loss and week-block paired Brier differences. No re-tuning after results.
protocol.releaseRule: Only consider activating this candidate if its paired week-block Brier difference upper bound is below zero against a 50 percent line benchmark in BOTH retrospective years, and point MAE is no worse than market in both years. Even passing this diagnostic is not proof of profitable odds; prospective tracking remains required.
protocol.onFailure: Keep totals as comparison-only research, with no actionable total selection or automated AI totals pick. Preserve the candidate and evidence for forward testing. Do not force total picks.

release.reason: Predeclared paired probability and point-error comparison in both reused retrospective years; no prospective profit validation
